clue.text: They work hard on Greek course

parts.note: afters is a British informal word for the dessert course of a meal

explanation.surface: Students putting effort into a Greek language course.
explanation.walkthrough: AFTERS is British slang for pudding, the course that comes after the main dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A grafter is British slang for a diligent, hard-working person, so the plural describes people who toil.

clue.text: Relative receives a politician, one from old Scottish region

indicators.note: the relative takes in the following letters, so they go inside her name

parts.note: a gran is a grandmother, a relative
MP stands for Member of Parliament
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A family member hosts a politician who hails from an old Scottish region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one from' looks like the definition's start, but 'one' gives I and 'from' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Grampian was a local-government region of north-east Scotland from 1975 to 1996, now abolished.

clue.text: Goddess's origin revealed in article on Egypt

definitions.note: read as 'Goddess is', the definition followed by a link

indicators.note: the origin word is shown sitting within the letters of article plus Egypt

parts.note: A is the indefinite article
E is short for Egypt in the clue's abbreviation
a start is an origin or beginning

explanation.surface: A goddess's origins are disclosed in a magazine article about Egypt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Goddess's' is read as 'Goddess is', with the 's acting as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Astarte was a Phoenician fertility deity, worshipped across the ancient Near East including Egypt.

clue.text: Giant bird starts to attack nestlings

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird

indicators.note: the starts of the next two words give their opening letters

explanation.surface: A huge bird begins to attack baby birds in a nest.
explanation.definitionFit: The Titans were the giant deities of Greek myth, so a titan is any giant of a figure.

clue.text: Writer, one travelling with old woman to part of France

parts.note: a rider is someone who travels on a horse or bike
a hag is an ugly old woman
the Gard is a department in southern France

explanation.surface: An author goes on a journey with an elderly lady to a corner of France.
explanation.definitionFit: H. Rider Haggard was a Victorian novelist, author of King Solomon's Mines and She.

clue.text: Good shot! Birdie at start of round

parts.note: a snipe is a wading bird

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word round is taken

explanation.surface: A golfer is praised for a fine shot, scoring a birdie at the start of the round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Birdie' and 'round' suggest golf; here birdie is simply a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A sniper is a marksman firing from cover, someone who is an accurate shot.

clue.text: Measure of gold could get you in a trance

indicators.note: the letters of the next phrase could be worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Gold's allure is said to hypnotise anyone who looks at it.
explanation.definitionFit: Carat measures the purity of gold; nine-carat gold is 9 parts in 24 pure.

clue.text: Anticipate pint container for drink to be served up

indicators.note: the pint abbreviation holds the following word inside it
in a down clue, served up means the word goes upwards, read backwards

parts.note: cider is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Expecting a pint glass of cider to be brought out.
explanation.definitionFit: To predict something is to foresee or expect it, the same as anticipating it.

clue.text: Chap has wish to do right, being upstanding

indicators.note: in a down clue the pieces stand up, so they read from bottom to top

parts.note: a yen is a longing or wish

explanation.surface: A man wants to behave properly and be an upright citizen.
explanation.definitionFit: Rodney is a man's first name, and crosswords freely use any male name for a chap.

clue.text: It is apparent during a piano duet, possibly

definitions.text: It is apparent during a piano duet, possibly

indicators.note: the word It shows itself in the middle of the following letters

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

indicators.note: possibly signals the word duet may be rearranged

explanation.surface: Talent shows itself when two pianists play together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns duet into TUDE, and IT sits between its T and U after A and P.
explanation.definitionFit: Aptitude is natural talent, the very quality that shows itself in a fine performance.

clue.text: Mean ultimately to have ambassador expelled

indicators.note: the ambassador's letters are thrown out of the phrase

parts.note: ultimately means in the end, finally
HE stands for His Excellency, title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: A cruel plan to have an envoy kicked out of the country.
explanation.walkthrough: HE (His Excellency, the form of address for an ambassador) is removed from IN THE END.
explanation.definitionFit: To mean to do something is to plan or have it in mind, the verb synonym.

clue.text: Stuck with the blues recording being played well into the night?

parts.note: a disc is a record, a recording
a record that is on is being played
so late describes a time far into the night

explanation.surface: Someone depressed keeps a blues record playing into the small hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Disconsolate means miserable and beyond comfort, stuck in a low mood.

clue.text: Miscreant and heartless prisoner forming such a team?

indicators.note: the letters are put together to shape something new
the central pair of letters of prisoner is removed

explanation.surface: A villain and a callous inmate join up as a crooked duo.
explanation.walkthrough: PRISONER loses its middle SO to give PRINER, then 'forming' shuffles it with MISCREANT.
explanation.definitionFit: Partners in crime are accomplices, a pair or gang working together on wrongdoing.

clue.text: Bitter berries starting to appear on tree

parts.note: acer is the maple genus of trees

indicators.note: only the opening letter of berries is used

explanation.surface: Sour fruit begins to show on a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Acerb is a rare synonym of acerbic, sharp and sour in taste.

clue.text: Who might have entitlement to be in top class?

definitions.text: Who might have entitlement to be in top class?

indicators.note: the entitlement word is placed inside the top-class word

parts.note: best means top-quality
a right is an entitlement

explanation.surface: Asking who deserves a place in the leading class at school.
explanation.definitionFit: The brightest pupils are the cleverest, who might fairly expect a place in the top set.

clue.text: Precise account given by cleric

parts.note: a curate is an assistant member of the clergy

explanation.surface: An exact report provided by a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Accurate means correct in every detail, exactly like precise.

clue.text: French tramp not initially smelling nice

indicators.note: the tramp word loses its first letter

parts.note: a vagrant is a tramp

explanation.surface: A French vagrant who, surprisingly, smells pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Fragrant describes a sweet or pleasant scent, so it means smelling nice.

clue.text: Taking the plunge after endless delightful booze

indicators.note: the last letter of the delightful word is cut off

parts.note: divine means wonderful or delightful
gin is an alcoholic spirit

explanation.surface: Someone takes a dive after a heavenly gin session.
explanation.definitionFit: Diving in means jumping into water or, figuratively, committing boldly to something.

clue.text: Being silly, and in a state about it

indicators.note: the state abbreviation goes round the word it

parts.note: NY is New York, a US state

explanation.surface: Acting foolishly while flustered about something.
explanation.definitionFit: Inanity is silliness or pointlessness, the condition of being senseless.

clue.text: Italian banker has billions invested in bank

indicators.note: the billions letter is put inside the bank word, as money goes into a bank

parts.note: a tier is a row or bank of seats

explanation.surface: An Italian financier has put billions into a bank.
explanation.walkthrough: A banker in crosswords is often a river, which has banks.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tiber flows through Rome, a river with banks, so a cryptic banker.

clue.text: Stand up as blister bursts

indicators.note: the word blister breaks apart, its letters reforming

explanation.surface: A burst blister stands proud of the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair bristles when it stands on end, so the verb means stand up stiffly.

clue.text: Might penny-farthing be seen as so cheap?

definitions.text: Might penny-farthing be seen as so cheap?

parts.words: Might penny-farthing be seen as so cheap?
parts.note: a penny and a farthing are two small coins, ... of change, and the phrase for a pair of bits means cheap or worthless

explanation.walkthrough: A penny-farthing is a high-wheeled bicycle; read as a penny and a farthing (an old quarter-penny coin) it is two coins.
explanation.definitionFit: Two-bit is an American idiom for cheap or trifling, originally worth a quarter dollar.

clue.text: Storm-battered Brighton, we read, installed a form of protection against the elements

definitions.text: form of protection against the elements

indicators.note: the single letter is put in place inside the rearranged letters
battered by a storm, the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Seafront Brighton, wrecked by a storm, has fitted shelter against the weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Weatherboarding is overlapping timber cladding on outside walls that keeps rain and wind out.

clue.text: Entering motorway maybe one went at speed

indicators.note: the one word goes inside the road abbreviation

parts.note: a motorway is one kind of road, abbreviated RD
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.surface: A driver joins the motorway and speeds off.
explanation.definitionFit: Raced is the past tense of race, meaning moved very fast.

clue.text: Corrupted wife taken into bed

indicators.note: the wife word is placed inside the bed word

parts.note: rib refers to Eve, made from Adam's rib, so a wife

explanation.surface: A spouse lured into bed has been led astray.
explanation.walkthrough: RIB for wife is from Genesis, where Eve is formed from Adam's rib.
explanation.definitionFit: To bribe is to corrupt someone with payment, so bribed means corrupted.

clue.text: What can be obtained from Italian deli? Pâté can't surprisingly

definitions.text: What can be obtained from Italian deli?

indicators.note: the letters of the two words turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A shopper is surprised an Italian deli has no pâté.
explanation.definitionFit: Pancetta is cured Italian pork belly, a staple of Italian delicatessens.

clue.text: Bash Street Kids ultimately dates

parts.note: to have a bash is to have a try

indicators.note: only the final letter of the word Kids is taken

explanation.surface: The Bash Street Kids, a British comic strip in the Beano, finally go on dates.
explanation.definitionFit: A tryst is a secret meeting between lovers, a romantic date.

clue.text: Bum getting whacked

definitions.meaning: a bum is an idle layabout or loafer
whacked is slang for utterly exhausted

explanation.definitionFit: A deadbeat is a lazy idler, and dead beat means completely worn out.
